channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Thomas Bryant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Thomas Bryant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Rui Hachimura
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Rui Hachimura playing SF and Thomas Bryant at PF next season:

“We will definitely take a look at it,depending on the makeup of the rest of our team.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Rui Hachimura, Aug 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant:

“He brought the energy. He brought the juice. He gave us some offense. He committed on both ends of the floor…I thought he was outstanding tonight.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
“We played with physicality and I thought [Bryant] gave us some toughness, and it’s unfortunate he didn’t start the game that way and we got to be able to do that throughout the game.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Mar 4, 2020. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Brooks on Thomas Bryant's bounceback game:

“We met yesterday, and he was frustrated. I like that. I like guys that are bothered when they play bad. ... First thing he said is, coach I'm not happy with the way I played — and he used a few other words that I'd rather not discuss.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Mar 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant's raise-the-roofs:

“Love it. ... [But] he's been told many times, if you're doing that and get scored on, the next time you're gonna be sitting next to me.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Feb 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on Thomas Bryant's minutes if Howard starts and gets regular playing time:

“I don't know where we'll find him minutes off the bench but we'll tryto make something happen.”

Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Thomas Bryant, Nov 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on Thomas Bryant:

“He's on the court constantly. We have to kick him off the court.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Nov 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant:

“We're looking forward to seeing how he plays. There obviously will be a learning curve ... but we're excited.”

Scott Brooks on Thomas Bryant, Nov 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
